target: The unqualified finite-sample v1 type-I bound
test: The paper's U-statistic ratio, plug-in variance estimator, Gaussian threshold, alpha=0.05
acceptance: FALSIFIED only if exact ordered-sample enumeration exceeds alpha and an independent brute-force enumeration agrees to 1e-12.
negative_control: Replacing z_0.95 with z_0.50 must increase rejection mass.
